instruction: Candid documentary photograph of a minimalist indoor studio with a solid beige wall. On the left, the dark-haired girl (R1) in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts stands on one leg, holding her other leg up in a high side split. On the right, the brown-haired girl (R6) in a matching beige outfit stands on one leg, holding her other leg up in a mirrored high side split. Both look forward with neutral expressions. Soft, even front lighting illuminates the scene, creating a warm, minimalist beige color palette.
